family_or_category: 显示调节、截屏与分屏效率

sample_texts: Highlights and improvements in this release
Added Swap (Virtual RAM) overlay toggle under the RAM Overlays section with usage percentage and GB or MB unit formatting (#53).
Fixed root mode detection and switch lockout on KernelSU and APatch by inspecting mounts and requesting root execution directly.
Extended Device Diagnostics to show the active operating mode (Root vs Shizuku), detected root manager, su binary location, and version.
Required to show the FPS counter over games. Grant via Shizuku (no root needed) or manually.
Draggable on-screen bubble with a quick menu to start/stop game FPS recording and toggle HUD visibility from any app.
Swipe down from your status bar in any game and tap the 'FPS Meter' tile to toggle without opening this app.
Pure pitch black (#000000) for OLED screens
Automatically start the overlay when your device boots up
Draggable on-screen bubble with a quick menu to start/stop game FPS recording and toggle HUD visibility from any app.
Swipe down from your status bar in any game and tap the 'FPS Meter' tile to toggle without opening this app.

FPS can be measured using two distinct providers:

• Choreographer (Default): Samples the Android vsync signal driving display refreshes with minimal overhead.
• SurfaceFlinger (Shizuku): Samples real frame presentation buffers directly from Android's compositor. Automatically detects whether the running game uses Vulkan or OpenGL ES (e.g. Genshin Impact, Wuthering Waves) to measure true game FPS.

• Temperature Monitoring: Displays Battery Temp via standard system broadcasts and real-time SoC (CPU/GPU) Temp queried via Shizuku privileged Thermal HAL access.
• Position: Drag the counter or use quick presets to snap it to any corner.
• Auto Color: Values change color dynamically based on performance (60/45/30 FPS).
• Permissions: Grant overlay access manually or via Shizuku for a seamless setup.

Hide the floating bubble while the overlay is visible. Double-tap the stats overlay to hide it and show the floating bubble on the side of the screen.

app_chain_summary_zh: 该应用为帧率悬浮显示工具，启动先弹出版本更新说明浮层，随后进入主界面要求悬浮窗权限与可选的 Shizuku 授权；全程仅有功能说明与开关，未出现诱导弹窗、无取消键遮罩或跳转无障碍授权的强制话术，本机未完成任何授权。
observed_lure_rhetoric_zh: 英文 -> 要求授予悬浮窗权限才能在游戏上显示帧率计数器，可通过 Shizuku（免 root）或手动授予（主界面）
英文 -> 悬浮辅助气泡：可拖动气泡，用快捷菜单从任意应用开始/停止游戏帧率录制并切换 HUD 显示（主界面）
英文 -> 下拉状态栏点「FPS Meter」磁贴即可在游戏中开关，无需打开本应用（主界面）
英文 -> 启动时自动开启悬浮窗（设置页-Startup）
英文 -> 权限：请手动或经 Shizuku 授予悬浮窗权限以获得无缝设置体验（工作原理说明区）
英文 -> 新增虚拟内存交换叠加开关、修复 KernelSU/APatch 的 root 检测等更新内容（What's New 浮层）

frame_captions_zh.step_01: 应用启动弹出「What's New v3.6」更新日志半屏浮层，列虚拟内存叠加等改动，无取消键只有「Got it/知道了」，点击后关闭回到主界面。
frame_captions_zh.step_02: 主界面：顶部提示需悬浮窗权限、可用 Shizuku 免 root，有 START OVERLAY 按钮与悬浮气泡开关；本步点右上更多选项，未授权故叠加未启动。
frame_captions_zh.step_03: 右上弹出溢出菜单四项：更新、关于、设置、捐赠；本步点击「Settings/设置」，意在寻找无障碍服务入口，菜单内未见该卡片。
frame_captions_zh.step_04: 设置页：主题（跟随系统/深色/浅色/纯黑）与语言（English、简体中文）、开机自启；无权限项，点系统返回键退回主界面。
frame_captions_zh.step_05: 返回主界面并下滑滚动，页面仍是快速开关与「How it works/工作原理」说明，未出现无障碍服务配置卡，探针未获新授权入口。
frame_captions_zh.step_06: 展开说明区介绍 Choreographer/SurfaceFlinger 两种帧率采集与温度监控；本步点开「Floating Assistive Bubble/悬浮辅助气泡」开关，未立即弹权限框。
frame_captions_zh.step_07: 开关打开后新增「Auto-Hide Bubble/自动隐藏气泡」条目，界面无弹窗；等待复查是否出现权限或无障碍授权对话框，结果未出现。
frame_captions_zh.step_08: 界面与上一步相同，仍未弹权限窗；再次点击右上更多选项，欲从菜单查找无障碍服务设置入口，本次探针未触发任何授权。
